method: Recurrent native actor-critic with observed returns until next external assignment or four game seconds, verified terminal without bootstrap; otherwise frozen V at actual cutoff state. Retain own option release. Mask auxiliary targets across intervention. Use elapsed-time discounts. Keep fixed variants, seed, data and optimizer.

Require exact executable parity on three complete trio tapes and at least one actual changed key. Score independent original-condition fights starting Unity 9926000. Log actual recurrent decisions/changes. Retire on third loss.
